_about: Every thing that orbits Sol is a body of one of these kinds. Add a kind here and a new body file in registry/bodies/, and the orbit, list, search and detail views pick it up with no view code.

human.label: Person
human.about: A founder, a hire, a contractor or an outside advisor. Orbits Sol or the division they work in.

division.label: Division
division.about: A department with a lead, a mission and its own moons.

project.label: Project
project.about: Time-boxed work with a goal and a date. Orbits Sol when it crosses divisions, else its division.

agent.label: Agent
agent.about: An AI seat with an approver. Orbits its division.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.about: A repeatable routine a division runs.

product.label: Product
product.about: Something customers or the team use.

tool.label: Tool
tool.about: An outside system the company runs on. Shown in the Toolbelt, not in orbit, unless it sets orbits.

rings._about: Default ring by kind when a body orbits Sol vs. anything else. A body can set its own ring.

tiers._about: Who may see a body and the data rows attached to it. Roles: founder sees all; lead sees open and studio; staff sees open; investor sees only bodies tagged investor.
